provenance.coverage: 3 parser checks, 5 adapter discovery checks (managed exclusion, stopped/container-less projects, read-only, failure), 10 adoption checks (service record, rehydrated rows, deployment digests, provenance warnings, audit, reconciler no-op, stopped/minimal projects, double-manage and conflict guards, NotFound paths) and 2 preservation checks.
provenance.derivation: Real merged PR #127 (closes #126) at its exact base b2cddbd. The instruction is the historical issue scope plus an explicit contract section so hidden checks are deterministic. The agent tree is a faithful TypeScript slice of the monorepo at base: host-adapters discovery.ts, docker-compose-adapter.ts (compose/discovery surface; compiler, ingress, backup, export and rotate omitted) and index.ts, plus read-only control-plane support (re-adoption with reconstructFromObserved, the real Reconciler and state machine, NotFoundError, row types). Only mechanical changes were made: .ts import specifiers, relative paths for the @kirkland/host-adapters workspace import, constructor parameter properties rewritten as fields (Node type stripping is erasable-only), MANAGED_LABEL inlined from @kirkland/compiler, the re-adoption catalog/topology seam reduced to an interface, and the drizzle/SQLite repository replaced by an in-memory store with the same surface, primary-key and foreign-key checks. The reference is the merged non-test diff (4 files, +312 lines) with the same mechanical adaptations. The hidden scenarios re-express the PR's vitest cases on held-out projects. They drive the real DockerComposeAdapter over a scripted docker CLI that models compose ls --all vs running-only, NDJSON/noise output, network- and volume-labelled managed projects, container-less and stopped projects, and records every call to detect mutations. They also run the real Reconciler after import to prove no redeploy.
provenance.historical_exposure: Private history; sanitized slice with held-out project fixtures has low recognition risk.
provenance.limitations: No model trial, representative-day coverage, native isolation, or contamination-free claim.
